answer: Nebula-bounded identity slots: each agent has a capacity slot whose maximum clones is capped by the ripple effect of its verified activity record. Honest agents accumulate a velvet-smooth history of unique, mutually-distinct interactions; cloning forces duplication that collapses diversity scores. Enforcing rule: an identity's slot count scales with distinct counterparties, so N clones must fabricate N genuinely distinct interaction chains, costing real work per clone. Attacker pays full fabrication cost per identity, not a discounted registration fee.
